title: REQ · Manifest ui entries carry dimensions that match the SVG files
summary: ui:icon-sound, ui:panel-frame and ui:cursor-pointer record dimensions and resolve under game/public/assets.
description: Context: the three ui manifest entries have id, path and type but no dimensions, and the asset manifest requires dimensions for the asset records. Desired behavior: add dimensions 16x16, 24x24 and 16x16 matching the SVG width and height attributes. Expected result: the manifest still validates and every ui path resolves. Why: SG-2.7 asks for matching manifest entries.
acceptance_criteria: Given manifest.json, When parsed with parseManifest, Then ok is true
Given the ui:icon-sound entry, When read, Then dimensions is {width:16,height:16}; ui:panel-frame is {24,24}; ui:cursor-pointer is {16,16}
Given each ui entry path, When resolved under game/public/assets, Then the file exists and its SVG width and height equal the entry dimensions

in_scope: The three ui entries in manifest.json
preserve: ids and paths of all entries

technical_constraints: dimensions must be positive integers per dimensionsSchema
definition_of_done: Manifest ui entries have correct dimensions
